title: Training versus inference cost asymmetry
caption: The book's opening comparison of one inference against a full training run -- the orders-of-magnitude gap that motivates the whole chapter. Our physics table carries the same point as a row of numbers; theirs shows it as a shape.

title: The iron law applied to training
caption: The D.A.M product split for a training run -- Data supplies D, Algorithm supplies the 6P coefficient, Machine supplies R_peak and eta. Ours decomposes the same law through the utilization factor; theirs labels the taxonomy axes.

title: Optimizer state across optimizers
caption: The book's comparison of bytes-per-parameter under SGD, momentum, and Adam. Our four-term budget equation fixes the mixed-precision Adam recipe at 16 B/param; theirs shows how the recipe choice moves the static floor.

title: Margin figure: pipeline staging
caption: One of the book's margin sketches on the staged input pipeline. Our overlap-timeline diagram carries the serial-to-max argument as a worked numeric example; theirs sketches the same staging abstractly.

title: Margin figure: memory components
caption: The book's margin view of training-state components. Our memory-staircase chart plots the walkthrough's actual GB values descending into capacity; theirs shows the component taxonomy.

title: Margin figure: scaling behavior
caption: The book's margin sketch of scaling efficiency. Our sync-share chart makes the mechanism quantitative -- the fixed ~1.75x gradient volume against shrinking per-replica compute; theirs shows the scaling curve.
